topic: Buying weekly scratch off tickets vs auto investing the same twenty dollars (Jethro vs Gloria)

scenes.narration: Weekly scratch offs add up to thirty thousand dollars over thirty years. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a pile of scratched lottery tickets beside a rising investment chart, comic burst banner reads THIRTY THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Jethro and Gloria both stop at the same gas station every Friday.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split gym panel of man jethro and woman gloria at a gas station counter on a Friday, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Jethro buys twenty dollars of scratch offs for a little hope.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man jethro buying a strip of scratch tickets, a thought bubble shows a jackpot, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He wins five bucks here and there. Never the big one.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man jethro scratching tickets with a coin, small wins reading FIVE and a pile of losers, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Over a year he spends one thousand forty dollars and wins back two hundred.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a treadmill display reading ONE THOUSAND FORTY OUT, TWO HUNDRED IN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Thirty years later, he has spent thirty one thousand dollars on paper.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man jethro older, standing on a mountain of scratched tickets, a tally reads THIRTY ONE THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Gloria sets an automatic twenty dollar weekly transfer to an index fund.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman gloria setting up a transfer reading TWENTY WEEKLY into an account labeled INDEX FUND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She never sees the money. It just quietly goes in.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman gloria driving past the gas station lottery sign without stopping, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: At a seven percent return, year one is about one thousand eighty.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a chart with a first bar reading ONE THOUSAND EIGHTY, a tag reads SEVEN PERCENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Thirty years later, her boring transfers are worth over one hundred thousand.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a chart climbing to ONE HUNDRED THOUSAND, woman gloria flexing beside it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Jethro has a shoebox of losers. Gloria has a six figure account.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man jethro with a shoebox of tickets, woman gloria with a statement reading ONE HUNDRED THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Guaranteed growth beats a one in a million ticket. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym, holding a clipboard reading AUTO INVEST THE TWENTY, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
